Outgoing request header in the client. The header name comes from HttpAuthConfig in code, and the value is the access token from our own auth API. fetch rejects CR/LF in header values with a TypeError.
Generated UI component (components/ui). The CSS comes from ChartConfig colors and the chart id, which are set in code. No user input reaches the style element.
Developer and CI script. SCA_ALLOWLIST_PATH is set by the operator who runs the script; there is no lower-trust caller.
Developer and CI script. The SARIF path is the operator's own argv; the script only reads it.

Cache path for the osv-scanner download. Version, platform and arch come from the operator's env and process; the folder is under node_modules/.cache.

Fixed file name inside the private mkdtempSync folder.
spawnSync with an argument array and no shell. The binary comes from OSV_SCANNER_BIN, PATH or the pinned release download, all chosen by the operator.
Developer and CI script. The plan name is the operator's own argv and is only checked for existence.

The ZAP container runs as its own user and must write reports into the bind-mounted .zap-reports folder, whose host owner has a different uid on CI. The folder is git-ignored and holds only scan output.
Developer script. The prefix comes from the REPOS map in the script, not from outside input.
Test configuration. Alias paths come from the exports map in the tracked packages/core/package.json; no untrusted source reaches them.
